subject: Meridian Health — compressing demo to recorded + 30m live Q&A (travel week)
messages:
From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling the Redwood demo for Meridian field week

Hi Karthik —

Quick update from our side: our VP of Ops (who we wanted in the demo) is on a client round-the-country trip that week and the travel schedule just moved — they only have a 45-minute slot on Wednesday afternoon local time. We still want to see Redwood, but with that constraint we're wondering if you can compress the standard 90-minute walkthrough into a short recorded walkthrough plus a 30-minute live Q&A focused on integrations and sizing.

Would that format work for you? If yes, can we get a short recording up front that we can circulate internally before the live Q&A? Also, can you confirm someone technical will be on the live Q&A to address KV cache, batching, and dedicated pools?

Thanks — Taylor
Senior Program Manager, Meridian Health

[Attachment: Meridian-MAP_v2.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian Health — compressing demo to recorded + 30m live Q&A (travel week)

Hi Taylor —

Thanks for the heads up — totally understand the travel squeeze. We can absolutely do a short pre-recorded walkthrough (15–20 minutes) plus a 30-minute live Q&A. Proposed plan: 1) I’ll record a concise walkthrough highlighting routing, KV caching, and cost levers; 2) Marissa (Solutions Engineer) will join the live Q&A to deep dive on integration/throughput; 3) Monica (Customer Success) will lead the mutual next steps and pilot checklist.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue, Jun 29 — shared recording + short runbook (we can host on Drive)
- Wed, Jun 30, 2:00–2:30pm ET — live Q&A (we can shift +/- 30 mins if needed)

We’ll include a short runbook (attaching a proposed runbook) and a 1-slide checklist for the VP. Do you want additional attendees from our architect team on the Q&A? If so, suggest questions/areas we should prep for.

I’ll loop in Marissa and Monica to confirm coverage.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0122

[Attachment: proposed-demo-runbook.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian Health — compressing demo to recorded + 30m live Q&A (travel week)

Taylor —

Happy to cover the live Q&A — I’ll plan to focus on:
- integration points (API auth, KMS options)
- performance: expected tail latency at 500–1k reqs/min and batching strategy
- sizing/dedicated pools and fallback routes for regional failover

Dev — can you be on standby in case the customer wants deeper kernel/quantization details?

Also, quick ask for Taylor: can you confirm the time zone for the VP (I have them in CT) and whether the 45-minute slot is fixed? If compressed further we can run the Q&A as 20 minutes + follow-up doc.

I’ll prep the demo-recording-short.mp4 and upload to the drive by EOD Tue.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@meridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@meridianhealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian Health — compressing demo to recorded + 30m live Q&A (travel week)

Thanks all — VP is CT and the 45-minute slot is firm. Your proposed format looks good. Please go ahead with the recording and runbook. We’ll push the recording internally and confirm the final Q&A time by Wednesday morning CT (likely 2:00–2:30pm CT).

A couple of quick asks for the recording/Q&A prep:
- One slide on data residency + audit logs (SOC2 evidence)
- Short note on how dedicated vs hosted would change the rollout timeline
- Attachment-friendly summary we can send to procurement (pricing tiers + lead times)

We appreciate the flexibility — look forward to Marissa’s recording.

Best,
Taylor
Senior Program Manager, Meridian Health
[Drive link to VP calendar slot provided separately]
